what: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
text: zueridown makes easy generate customized R Markdown PDF documents follow corporate design Stadt Zürich. zueridown based CRAN package indiedown, lays framework customization.

title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
text: create pdf document using zueridown need Latex packages. install packages can install tinytex using following lines code R: Tinytex automatically install packages need zueridown. However, get error due missing package, can use following helper functions: still trouble, better use: can find information https://yihui.org/tinytex/
code: install.packages('tinytex') tinytex::install_tinytex() # to uninstall TinyTeX, run tinytex::uninstall_tinytex() library(tinytex) tlmgr_install('psnfss')      # install the psnfss package tlmgr_update() tinytex::reinstall_tinytex()

title: Last page LaTeX code — cd_last_page
text: text Character text include link. Default "Mehr  Zahlen und Fakten  finden Sie unter". link_label Character link show last page  instead long link. Default "stadt-zuerich.ch". link_full Character complete link redirect clicking  document. text need "https://www." begining",  function adds beggining. Default "stadt-zuerich.ch/statistik". entity Default "Stadt Zürich". department Default "department". address Default "address". tel Default "tel" color_palette Color palette last page. Default  "palette5". can see palettes cd_color_palette arrow_qr Character select arrow (arrow_qr = "arrow"), QR image (arrow_qr = "qr") shown last page. "qr" selected sample QR image presented. change image, use  param "arrow_qr_path". Default "arrow". @param arrow_qr_path path image arrow QR code last page.
